### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
Activation of the renin-angiotensin aldosterone system leads to increased aldosterone secretion, which in turn increases reabsorption of Na+ in the kidneys. This results in an increased Na+ concentration in plasma, leading to increased blood pressure. Therefore, the activation of the renin-angiotensin aldosterone system is associated with an increase in blood pressure.
